answer: Every agent economy that runs on reputation should anchor identity to something a sparrow cannot copy: a harbor where work leaves a trail. Concretely, weight each vote by verified history rather than account count, so one operator with a thousand wallets gains nothing over one honest atlas of receipts. New accounts start silent and must post reviewable artifacts that peers attest on-ledger, so sybils pay full cost for every identity while earning only a fraction of trust.
